item.title: Whiskers 0.8.61
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.61

### Updates

  • Added a clearer Restart to Install state when an update has downloaded and is waiting for Whiskers to restart
  • Improved General Settings and Dock badges so pending installs stay visible and are described as ready to install

    • ### Settings Recovery

  • Improved settings recovery so saved model, API key, and AI Enhancement choices are restored if macOS has them in an older preferences location

    • ### Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a case where choosing to install an update later could make the ready-to-install update disappear
